entries.title: Gravity and quantum information linked through a derivation of Einstein's equations
entries.summary: Recent research shows that gravity and quantum information are deeply connected and that the shape of spacetime can be traced back to the way information is stored in quantum fields.

entries.title: Magnetic sculpting transforms single-source fields into predetermined shapes with mathematical precision
